headlines.title: Maine Democrats select Troy Jackson as Senate candidate

headlines.title: Saudi Arabia trades fire with Iran-backed rebels in Yemen
headlines.description: There were no new strikes against Iran overnight. The pause comes as there appears to be a new warfront opening in the Middle East, with Saudi Arabia and Iran-backed Houthi rebels trading fire. NBC News’ Richard Engel reports from Jerusalem.
